title: vaccinium vitis-idaea var. genuinum
intro: Vaccinium vitis-idaea var. genuinum, commonly known as the Mountain Cranberry, is a low-growing, evergreen shrub native to the Arctic and subarctic regions. This plant is rich in nutrients and offers several health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help protect against cell damage, reduce inflammation, and prevent infections. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Cranberry include anti-diarrheal, anti-ulcer, and anti-gastric acid effects, which can help alleviate digestive issues and provide relief from stomach ulcers. The bioactive constituents of Vaccinium vitis-idaea var. genuinum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
